column2: So they struck while the professor was away and Mazinger was under repair...
So I had no choice but to head out in the Hover Pilder, and then...
You got swallowed up by the black moon, right?
I've gotta hurry to Science City and bring Professor Yumi back... or the Photon Power Lab will fall to the Mechanical Beast army!
All kinds of worlds are getting jumbled together, y'know. Who knows if Science City's even there?
Let's watch some TV to take our minds off things!
{!R}We interrupt this program to bring you a special news bulletin!
{!R}A strait has suddenly appeared, as if to encircle the foot of Mt. Fuji! {!R}No earthquake was recorded during this event! {!R}How could such a thing happen? {!R}The cause is a complete mystery!
It's the Kanto Hellquake...
So Jack's world is starting to eat into this one!?
{!R}What's more! Mysterious monsters have appeared in the skies over the strait! {!R}Monsters like beasts made of machinery! {!R}They are currently farting on the Photon Power Lab.
Did he just say "farting"...?
{!R}Pardon me! I got flustered! {!R}The monsters are currently FLANKING the Photon Power Lab!
{!R}This just in!\n\n{!R}A statement from Professor Yumi, who was attending the conference in Science City!
Professor Yumi!
Science City exists! And so does Professor Yumi...!
Huh? The picture suddenly went fuzzy...!?
{!R}Hear me, Professor Yumi!
{!R}I am Baron Ashura! Master of the Mechanical Beasts!
Whoa! What IS that!?
A man and a woman stuck together as one! Not even the Hell World's got anybody like that!
It's Dr. Hell's right hand, Baron Ashura!
{!R}I want you to hear my proposal! If you agree to the deal,
{!R}we'll withdraw every last Mechanical Beast!
{!R}The proposal is this...
{!R}Hand Mazinger Z over to us!
{!R}Yes!? Or no!?
{!R}Think it over verrry carefully!
{!R}Naturally, if the answer is no...\n\n{!R}until every last Japanese is dead and gone,
{!R}the Mechanical Beasts will run wild!
{!R}Yes!?
{!R}Or no!?
{!R}Wahahahahaha...!
{!R}Hohohohohoho...!
{!R}This is a terrible development!\n\n{!R}What will Professor Yumi in Science City decide...!? {!R}Will Mazinger Z fall into Baron Ashura's hands!?
Damn you, Baron Ashura!
Koji-kun! Where are you going!?
Let's go after him!
Uhh... *pant, pant*...
...Looks like she'll still fly!\n\nI'm heading to the Photon Power Lab now!
Shouldn't you talk to Professor Yumi first? And besides... the truth is, we want to go to Science City!
Why?
{s}...!? No, you need to stay in bed!
Those two got flung into this world together. And now {s} has come down with some mystery illness...
So you want to go to Science City for her...? All right, got it! Let's go to Science City together!
Koji-kun!
I'll take {s} in the Pilder. Once you're ready, we'll head out for Science City. Just say the word when you're set.
All set?
Then let's go!
Just say the word when you're set.
The Mechanical Beasts are surrounding the Photon Power Lab...
Damn Mechanical Beasts! Once I'm back from Science City, I'll smash 'em!
We're in Science City! Let's find Professor Yumi, quick!
Science City is the biggest research city in the world. It's got the very best technology, facilities and people.
The Photon Power Lab is surrounded by Mechanical Beasts!? Professor Yumi is at the Grand Conference Hall, but does he know about it?
North of Science City, three facilities stand side by side: the Grand Conference Hall, the research facility and the medical facility. Best keep that in mind.
Even if the world is destroyed by Mechanical Beasts... I shall continue my research! For the sake of the world...!
Let's see, pi is roughly 3, so...\n\nExcuse me, kindly don't disturb my research!
Research funding is plentiful, so the work's going great! No idea where the money comes from, though. Not interested.
It's kind of noisy...? Eh, Mechanical Beasts!? Hmm... I'm curious how they work...
There were some shady-looking men around. The man with them looked familiar, though...?
There are plenty of good doctors.\n\nBut you can't get an examination without someone's referral.
What!? A demand for Professor Yumi to hand over Mazinger? I don't think the professor's heard about that, has he?
When these research results are published, the whole world will be stunned! What are they about? I can't tell you that... not yet!
Viva science! I'm hap-pi-est when I'm doing research! Nothing else interests me!
The instrument readings look normal.
The Grand Conference Hall sounds rowdy. I wonder if something happened?
Look at this! The new equipment just arrived!
I, Genzo Kuruma, am explaining this myself, so why can you fools not understand!?
I acknowledge your theory!\n\nBut what you are trying to do is wrong!
Professor Yumi!
That's Professor Yumi?
Sit down, Dr. Kuruma!
Hear, hear!
Hmph! You're all fools after all. I thought I might make use of anyone who supported my lofty research, but I misjudged you.
What!? How rude!!
Watch your mouth, Dr. Kuruma!
Boo! Boo!!
Things are starting to get rough...
Uh-oh, it's not the kind of mood where we can get near Professor Yumi...
With the power of science, man can become a god or a devil! A god who saves mankind! Or a devil who destroys the world!
You call me a devil, Professor Yumi!?
By the way, Professor Yumi, do you know what a devil enjoys?
What a devil enjoys... is blood and screams of despair!
Third-rate scientists like you are of no use alive! At least suffer and entertain me! Hahahaha...!
Gyaaah!
Whoaaa!
Eeeek!
Oh no! We've got to save Professor Yumi!
Stupid fools! Defying Dr. Kuruma...!
We're gonna rough you up good... Hee hee hee hee...!
You there! Thank you for saving me!
Professor! Are you all right!?
Yes, I'm fine!\n\nBy the way, Koji-kun, what brings you here?
...Where is Genzo Kuruma?
The doctor went that way...
He's gone...
